Do your best impression of another player until someone guesses who it is.
Speak in a robot voice until your next turn.
Sing the chorus of the last song you listened to, loudly.
Let the group pick a funny contact name for you in someone's phone.
Do ten star jumps while saying the alphabet backwards as far as you can.
Talk without closing your mouth for the next minute.
Balance a spoon on your nose for ten seconds.
Act like a chicken until your next turn.
Let another player draw a moustache on you with a pen.
Tell a joke. If nobody laughs, do a forfeit chosen by the group.
Walk around the room like a model on a catwalk.
Say a tongue twister three times fast. The group decides if you passed.
Hold a plank for thirty seconds.
Do your best dance move for the next ten seconds.
Describe your day using only movie titles.
Let the person on your left give you a new nickname for the rest of the game.
Do an over-the-top news report about what just happened in this room.
Hop on one leg while telling a story about your last holiday.
Pretend you're a waiter and take everyone's drink order with a fake accent.
Show the last photo you took, no matter what it is.
